messages:
support-bot: Alert: spike in 5xx from hosted inference API across multiple regions. 5xx rate up from 0.4% -> 6.8% in last 7m. Several production customers reporting request timeouts and 502/504. Auto-alert created: INC-2026-0315-01

angela: seeing it on the console too — latency p50 stable but p99 skyrocketed, and error budget alarm tripped. Is this tied to the canary we pushed ~10m ago?

sam: yes canary started ~1782105400 (10m before alert). Canary config: rollout batcher=opt-v2, flags: prefer_quantized=true, enable_prefix_cache_v2=true. Canary weight 5% -> 20% over 5m.

matt: quick numbers from metrics: host:us-west-2 5xx went from 0.6% -> 12% on canary nodes. Non-canary hosts remain ~0.5%. Looks strongly correlated.

julia: customers reporting two main symptoms: 1) 502 Gateway Error immediate response, 2) 504 upstream timeout for streaming requests.

angela: can someone paste a failing request and runtime log? need repro before rollback if possible (but we should prepare rollback).

kevin: repro curl from prod (anonymized keys):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"long context repeated ...", "max_tokens":50}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* Received HTTP/2 stream 1 ERROR
< HTTP/2 502\n< content-type: application/json\n< x-request-id: req_abc123\n{\"error\":{\"type\":\"server_error\",\"message\":\"upstream error: runtime/load-failure\"}}\n```

sam: grabbing logs from a canary host now, tailing inference runtime logs. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T17:41:02Z [inference][ERROR] request_handler: failed to serve request req_abc123: RuntimeError: KV cache allocation failed for seq_len 4096
2026-03-15T17:41:02Z [inference][WARN]  worker-7: model reload attempt after load failure: FileNotFoundError: weights/quantized/v2/llama-13b/q8_0.bin not found
2026-03-15T17:41:03Z [proxy][ERROR] upsteam reset by peer for conn id=2345
```

matt: interesting — the model path missing line suggests the prefer_quantized=true flag routed some traffic to quantized model variants that aren't present on canary hosts (artifact layout mismatch). That would produce 5xx for affected requests and timeouts while the worker retries.

julia: can we verify the artifact layout on canary hosts?

sam: ssh to canary host and ls shows weights/quantized/v2 present on standard pool but path is different on canary due to build change: artifact uses weights/quantized/v3. Canary runtime expects v2. So mismatch between runtime flag and deployed artifact.

angela: root cause hypothesis: deploy pipeline promoted an image with updated kernel/batching code but the artifact sync step used a tag that didn't contain the expected quantized weights path; the flag prefer_quantized=true flipped routing to the missing path. Bad canary config plus artifact path drift -> 5xx.

kevin: customer repro steps (reduced):
1) set prompt > ~2k tokens or streaming mode
2) request to /v1/generate
3) service returns 502 with body above

angela: mitigation plan: immediate rollback of canary to previous image that has consistent artifact layout, and roll back feature flag prefer_quantized to false cluster-wide if needed. Who can trigger?

matt: I can roll back the canary image tag to redwood/inference:2026-02-28-prod. Will do a canary revert with weight 0 -> remove canary traffic.

sam: also unblock artifact sync to reconcile weights on canary hosts; but that takes longer — prioritize rollback first.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by matt: rollback canary redwood/inference:2026-03-15-opt-v2 -> redwood/inference:2026-02-28-prod. Canary weight set to 0 at 1782105785

support-bot: Noted: customer-facing support notified of rollback in progress. Watch for remaining 5xx after rollback for at least 10m, then update customers.

angela: after rollback, confirm metrics and tracing. sam, please watch p99 and 5xx rate and post screenshots. Julia, coordinate comms.

sam: rollback applied. within 90s we see p99 dropping and 5xx rate in canary nodes back to ~0.4%. Non-canary unchanged.

kevin: retest same curl now:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" ... https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
< HTTP/2 200\n{\"id\":\"resp_xxx\", \"output\": \"...\"}
```

julia: customer confirmations trickling in, a handful closed as resolved with apology & explanation.

angela: Actions: 
- incident owner: angela
- immediate: roll back canary (done)
- short-term: add guard in runtime: if quantized path missing, fallback to non-quantized model rather than 5xx (sam, matt)
- deploy pipeline: add artifact layout validation pre-promote (matt)
- feature flags: add preflight check before flipping cluster-wide (julia)
- postmortem: assign draft due EOD tomorrow (kevin)

sam: quick note: add metric alert for ModelLoadError / missing artifact path so we can detect earlier.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 1782105863. All canary hosts now running redwood/inference:2026-02-28-prod.

angela: closing the incident channel once we confirm 30m stable. Thanks all. Please log runbook updates. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01 resolved (provisional). 5xx rates returned to baseline. Follow-up tasks created in #postmortems.
_meta: generated for dataset: slack/incidents, topic: deploy/rollout regressions increasing 5xx (bad canary/config flag)
